reviewMethod: AI agents opened the PNGs through view_image and inspected the visible output. No human review is claimed.

reviewers.scope: Three Production additions views and two complete-workbook representative views.
All cibles-0 through cibles-18 additions views; rows 1 through 116.

findings: All four delivery rows and their source, limit and hash columns are visible without clipping.
All 111 target rows were reviewed across 19 contiguous views; the title, headers and alternating row fills are intact.
The two representative views rendered from the complete final workbook are byte-identical to the corresponding additions renders.
limitations: Microsoft Excel native rendering, recalculation and print pagination were not run.
The historical worksheets were preserved byte for byte, not all re-rendered; the V16 baseline summary preview was inspected separately during preparation.
This checks workbook presentation. Technical and browser QA results are sourced from the final production register and their dedicated reports; this is not a new game acceptance run.
No one-to-one image fidelity certification is made. Wide table previews require zoom for detailed reading.

views.finding: Title, 22 summary indicators, computed counts and full technical/browser scope fit their cells. The long scope in row 25 is visible without clipping.
All four delivery identities, category/file/base values and master/export paths are visible. Row heights follow the longer evidence columns in the same table.
All four source lists, detailed review limitations and both SHA-256 values per drawing are visible and contained within their rows.
